messages:
zara_cs: Morning team — quick pre-cutover check for Cambria Analytics private deployment. Two outstanding items: MTU mismatch on the VPN tunnel and BYOK import validation. Cutover is scheduled for 08:30 PT tomorrow. Runbook updated: https://wiki.redwood/cambria/runbook (audit + rollback sections).

ethan_net: Saw the MTU alert in staging this morning. Their on-prem edge is 1450, our TGW default path expects 1500. If we don't adjust DF or set MSS clamping they'll see fragmentation. Can Cambria change edge MTU or should we enable MSS clamp on our side?

maria_eng: We can enable MSS clamping on the gateway but need a quick test window. If we clamp to 1400 we should be fine for their traffic patterns. Also need confirmation that their VPN appliance supports rekey during the maintenance window.

priya_sec: For BYOK, Cambria wants to import an HSM-wrapped key. We need the key envelope format and a PKCS#11 confirmation. They submitted sample metadata but not the import check-sum. Without checksum we can't verify integrity post-import.

zara_cs: I asked Cambria for checksum and rekey window — they replied: can deliver key bundle tonight and allow a 90-minute maintenance window between 02:00-04:00 PT.

ethan_net: Good. For the MTU we can schedule a 15-min connectivity test 1 hour before cutover. I'll open a preflight ticket and share test commands.

maria_eng: Test commands (I'll run from prod-prober):
```
# check PMTU path to on-prem aggregator
sudo ping -M do -s 1372 10.11.0.2
# curl metrics endpoint through tunnel
curl -v https://10.11.0.2:8443/health || true
```
If ICMP with dont-frag fails at that size it's MTU issue.

priya_sec: Security checklist:
- Confirm BYOK key ARN and account match
- Verify PKCS#11 wrapper + checksum before import
- Create temporary import role with scoped kms:ImportKeyMaterial permissions
- Audit logs forwarded to their GCP BigQuery dataset (cambria-audit) with 30d retention for first week
We prefer BigQuery mirror for their analytics team, not Splunk.

zara_cs: Cambria requested BigQuery. I updated runbook to reflect BigQuery dataset and provided connector steps.

ethan_net: Another note: Cambria uses strict egress rules and blocks 443 to external telemetry. We need them to allow endpoints for our metrics and auto-scaling webhooks: telemetry.redwood.prod (54.12.34.56) and asg-webhook.redwood (54.98.76.10). Sent them an egress allow list in the ticket: https://support.cambria/TKT-7782

maria_eng: Also saw an issue with service endpoints: they don't have S3 VPC endpoint in their account; audit tool flagged cross-account bucket access will fail without it. Either we create a VPC endpoint in their VPC or provide a presigned upload flow. Which do they prefer?

zara_cs: Cambria prefers endpoint for simplicity. I'll confirm and request CIDR for endpoint routing.

priya_sec: Small policy nit: cross-account IAM role for import must have condition aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent = true for any console actions, but programmatic imports allowed without MFA. Documented in runbook.

monitor-bot: [monitor] preflight-scan: cambria-preflight-1999999123 completed. findings: 3 warnings (MTU, missing S3 endpoint, missing checksum). See: https://monitor.redwood/scan/1999999123

ethan_net: Next steps:
1) Cambria to provide checksum + HSM envelope (zara will confirm)
2) Team to run MTU test 07:30 PT tomorrow (ethan + maria)
3) Cambria to add egress allows for telemetry endpoints (zara to follow up on TKT-7782)
4) Create S3 VPC endpoint in customer account or enable presigned flow (zara to confirm)
5) Priya to prepare temporary import role and import runbook steps

zara_cs: I'll own 1, 3, and 4. Priya owns 5. Ethan and Maria please confirm test window. If any of these fail and cutover slips > 48 hours, flag renewal-risk per AE note (they want notice for pilot commitment).

maria_eng: Confirmed for 07:30 PT test window. I'll be on the call.

ethan_net: Confirmed. I'll coordinate netops with Cambria and update TKT-7782.

priya_sec: I'll post the import role snippet and checklist in this thread after I finish the policy review.

zara_cs: Thanks everyone — I will close when we have checksum + MTU green. Leaving notes in runbook and pinging AE for renewal-risk banner if slip occurs. :white_check_mark:
